summary.text: Greg DeVries is the Libertarian candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 75, in the November 3, 2026 general election against incumbent Mark Reinschmidt (R) and Democrat Patrick Sullivan.
He previously held the seat as a Republican from 2019 to 2021.

paragraphs.text: Greg DeVries served in the Montana House of Representatives, representing District 75 as a Republican, from January 7, 2019, to January 3, 2021.
During the 2019-2020 session he was assigned to the House Education, Judiciary and Local Government committees.
He lost the June 2, 2020 Republican primary for the seat to Marta Bertoglio, who succeeded him.
In 2026 he advanced from the Libertarian primary for District 75 on June 2.
